verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to opt out of telemetry, usage tracking, or request logging. The material that is present points the other way: a real-time usage analytics dashboard and MCP user-activity analytics. EU data residency and guardrails are adjacent privacy features, not an opt-out control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
